paragraphs.speaker: spk1
paragraphs.text: Looking forward, Irvington will continue to weave together its natural historic assets, present charm, future growth for the benefit of town. Irvington began as a steamboat port on Carter's Creek in 1873 and is now a picturesque historic village known for its strong sense of community, breathtaking scenery, recreational water activities, active working waterfront. Resident and visitors stroll our main street, meet in delightful restaurants and shops, and gather at the commons, farmers markets, and concerts and take pride in our traditional fourth of July parade.

paragraphs.speaker: spk1
paragraphs.text: All in all this, they experience a peaceful, connected, and deeply satisfying way of life. On the order of the renowned tides in lends grace and serenity to Irvington where close by busy marinas, boatyards and a yacht club and water activities all kinds flourish on the creek. We are stewards of all this beauty and bounty and we envision Irvington growing and evolving in ways that enhance our community life. Our character are in our residential area.

paragraphs.speaker: spk1
paragraphs.text: We encourage open green space, limited density, compatible architecture, and maintain our cherished rural village character. Recognizing our attraction for retirement and resort living as well as the appeal to young families seeking a close knit community, we support local small businesses as they anticipate emerging town and visitor needs and the continuing success of the Tides Inn. Our water is our jewel and we will continue to protect Carter's Creek and the Chesapeake Bay watershed environment for future generations.

paragraphs.speaker: spk1
paragraphs.text: We also support redevelopment of a working waterfront and innovative efforts to expand public access to the water. Envisioning the future in these ways respects Irvington's natural setting, historic appearance, and small town character while encouraging its recognized entrepreneurial spirit and potential. It also continues the town's long tradition of actively shaping its own destiny since incorporation in 1955. Preserving our community through purposeful change assures all of us that Irvington will be as exceptional tomorrow as it is today.
